title: A two-room workshop in Bandra
body: Preet Sahni and Raghu Menon start a small fit-out outfit with four carpenters and one van, working on flats within a mile of the office.

title: First full residential floor
body: A twelve-apartment handover in Powai proves the model: one drawing set, one site team, one point of contact until the last snag is closed.

title: Fabluxora Interiors is formed
body: The design studio is separated from site delivery so drawings, procurement and installation each have their own discipline.

title: Fabluxe Home Solutions opens
body: Clients kept asking who would specify and service the televisions, audio and appliances. The group answered by building the capability in-house.

title: Bengaluru and Pune studios
body: Two satellite studios open, taking the group to five cities and its first hospitality commissions.

title: Own joinery and finishing works
body: A 40,000 sq ft facility in Vasai brings joinery, veneer and metal finishing under group control, cutting handover timelines by a third.

title: Service network across eleven cities
body: After-sales engineers are placed in every city the group builds in, so a call is answered by someone who knows the installation.

title: 2,400 projects delivered
body: Two companies, 380 people, and a majority of new work still arriving through clients we have already worked for.
